name: Triara Megacenter Medellin modernization
notes: Claro describes 2025 strengthening of Triara for cloud, AI and cybersecurity; DCD reported US$3m specifically for modernizing the Triara Megacenter data center in Medellin, Antioquia, with wider Antioquia infrastructure investment.

name: GTD Colombia Data Center El Poblado
notes: Operator page says the El Poblado, Medellin facility has three independent operating white rooms, Uptime Institute Tier III design/construction/operations certification, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and ICREA Green Data Center certification; page notes +200 kVA available in white room.

name: InterNexa Medellin Data Center
notes: Facility directories list InterNexa Medellin at Cl. 12 Sur #18-168, Medellin; DCHub reports 3.0 MW and operational status.

name: V.tal BDC1 Barranquilla Edge Data Center
notes: V.tal announcement for BDC2 states it already had BDC1 in Barranquilla with 1 MW total power and 80 racks, housing the PIT traffic exchange and integrated with cable landing infrastructure.

name: V.tal BDC2 Barranquilla Edge Data Center
notes: V.tal inaugurated its second Colombian edge data center in Barranquilla with 3 MW total power, up to 200 racks and more than R$100m investment; DCD reports more than US$20m investment.

name: Telxius Cable TBAQ01 Barranquilla Data Center
notes: Facility directories identify Telxius Cable TBAQ01 at Ciudadela Universitaria, Barranquilla, Atlantico; DCHub reports 3.0 MW and operational status.

name: EdgeUno BAQ1 Barranquilla Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists EdgeUno BAQ1 at Calle 6 #20-10 lote A2, Sur Orient, Barranquilla, Atlantico, providing colocation/cloud/edge services.

name: Equinix BG1 Bogota IBX
notes: Equinix lists BG1 in the Zona Franca trade zone and states it is one of the largest data centers in Colombia; BG1 page lists 21,571 sq ft and N+1 power/cooling redundancy.

name: Equinix BG2 Bogota IBX
notes: Equinix lists BG2 in the same Zona Franca complex as BG1; newsroom announcement described a US$45m second Colombia data center with initial 550-cabinet capacity and 1,100 cabinets at full build.

name: Cirion BOG1 Bogota Data Center
notes: Cirion certification annex identifies BOG1 in Bogota, Colombia, supporting data center services including colocation, backup, bare metal cloud, hosting and managed services.

name: Cirion BOG2 Bogota Data Center
notes: Cirion operator page lists BOG2 at Cra. 68 #169a-27, Bogota, as a carrier-neutral data center serving more than 300 companies with colocation, bare metal, private cloud and managed hosting.

name: KIO BOG | 1 Bogota Data Center
notes: KIO operator page lists BOG | 1 in the Bogota Free Trade Zone as Tier III-certified with 2N redundant systems. DCD reported the acquired BOG1 facility has 6 MW capacity and adjacent land for a second data center; DataCenterMap reports 5.6 MW.

name: Takoda Bogota COLOMBIA1 Data Center
notes: Takoda operator page lists a Bogota Zona Franca facility at Carrera 106, 15A-25, Manzana 16, Lote 114C with N+1 generator/cooling topology, 2N UPS and 11 network providers; DataCenterMap reports 1 MW.

name: SONDA Zona Franca Bogota Data Center
notes: Baxtel lists SONDA's Zona Franca de Bogota data center as operational since 2018 with Uptime Institute Tier III certification.

name: Ascenty Bogota 1 Data Center
notes: Ascenty campus brochure says Colombia was selected for two new Bogota data centers; Bogota 1 is listed as 12 MW total power, 9,000 m2 total area and 1,300 racks.

name: Ascenty Bogota 2 Data Center
notes: Ascenty campus brochure lists Bogota 2 as under construction with 12 MW total power, 9,000 m2 total area and 1,300 racks; combined Colombia campus capacity is 24 MW.

name: Telxius Cable TCTG01 Cartagena Data Center
notes: Inflect lists Telxius Cable TCTG01 as an operated data center at 47-15 Carrera 17, Cartagena, Bolivar.

name: Contecar DataCenter Building Cartagena
notes: Conconcreto project page describes a Cartagena, Bolivar building called DataCenter for client Contecar S.A. in design stage: 1,119 m2 total, about 250 m2 data center and 750 m2 offices, with architecture, structural, MEP and BIM design scope.

name: Alcaldia de Tunja Data Center
notes: DCD and Boyaca Radio reported inauguration in Tunja, Boyaca of the municipal government's data center installation/optimization project by Powernet; public-sector facility rather than commercial colocation.
